title: Chapter 640 - 640 Staff Delivers Tea; Apologizes!
content:
Chapter 640 - 640 Staff Delivers Tea; Apologizes!

Chapter 640 - 640 Staff Delivers Tea; Apologizes!

640 Staff Delivers Tea; Apologizes!

Some people were just like that. They often thought that they were superior.

Little did the man know that his actions were just a joke in the eyes of many people.

Xia Xue frowned slightly. “It has nothing to do with you whether I’ve been to the Imperial Hotel or not. In addition, if I want to go, I’ll go myself!”

“Don’t be so quick to reject me so.” Xiong Kai chuckled and said, “Why don’t exchange contact information first and get to know each other better in the future?”

After that, Xiong Kai reached out to take Xia Xue’s phone.

“What are you doing?” Xia Xue shouted.

As soon as she finished speaking, she raised her hand and swatted Xiong Kai’s arm away, which made a clear sound.

“If you continue acting like this, I’ll call the police!”

Xiong Kai’s expression turned extremely ugly.

She hit his arm and even said she was going to call the police?

He seemed to feel that he had been greatly provoked and mocked her, “You said you went to the 365th floor of the Imperial Hotel for dinner? Who do you think you are? Ever since the establishment of the Imperial Hotel, it has never entertained anyone on the 365th floor!

“And if you really went to the 365th floor of the Imperial Hotel to eat, why would you be lining up here to buy Yuesse Snow Tea? The employees will send the drinks directly to you!”

After that, Xiong Kai sneered at Xia Xue.

He knew that Xia Xue seemed to be broadcasting live.

Now, there should be some audience members.

Xiong Kai wanted to expose Xia Xue in public!

Since he could not get her, she had to be punished!

At this moment, a deep voice suddenly sounded from the side.

“You’re right. Yuesse Snow Tea should send the drinks over.”

Xiong Kai and Xia Xue heard this and turned to look.

They saw a tall and handsome figure appear beside them.

It was Lin Fan!

For some reason, Xia Xue, who was originally a little angry, felt her anger instantly dissipate when she saw Lin Fan.

What replaced it was happiness, joy, and excitement!

Lin Fan smiled at Xia Xue and asked, “Xia Xue, what drink do you want to get?”

Xia Xue was a little stunned. “Uh… Ice… Ice Queen.”

Then, Lin Fan raised his super smart watch and said, “Get me two cups of Ice Queen.”

“Yes, Master!” The super smart watch made a crisp sound.

1,000 years ago, Lin Fan never took the initiative to talk to the super smart watch in front of others.

However, 1,000 years later, not to mention smart watches, even robots could be seen everywhere. Naturally, there was no need to hide from others.

After a while, three slender women wearing the custom-made uniforms of Yuesse Snow Tea walked over with brisk steps.

When they arrived in front of Lin Fan, they all bowed and said respectfully, “Hello, Mr. Lin. Here are two cups of Ice Queen for you.”

This scene made Xia Xue and Xiong Kai, as well as everyone in the queue, open their mouths wide in disbelief.

One had to know that this was Yuesse Snow Tea!

Even some bosses with a net worth of more than ten million had to queue up in advance if they wanted to have a sip of a drink from Yuesse Snow Tea.

When had they ever seen Yuesse Snow Tea’s staff personally deliver the drinks to them? Furthermore, three employees carried the drinks over and served them to a person with such respectful attitudes.

Lin Fan did not mind at all. He took a cup and said, “The other cup is for this lady.”

Thus, the staff of Yuesse Snow Tea handed the other cup to Xia Xue.

Xia Xue was stunned for a while before she slowly reached out and said, “Thank… Thank you.”

The staff of Yuesse Snow Tea, who were standing at the front, said, “You’re welcome. It’s our honor to make drinks for you.”

Honor?

That was right!

It was an honor!

Because they had just received a call from the headquarters and knew that this young Mr. Lin was the real boss of Yuesse Snow Tea!

If this beauty was with Mr. Lin, even if they were just ordinary friends, it was definitely worth it for them to curry favor with her.

If she was Mr. Lin’s girlfriend…

Thinking of this, the staff became even more respectful.

Then, Lin Fan looked at Xiong Kai again and said, “Your father is Xiong Anqing, a manager of the Imperial Hotel?”

Xiong Kai opened his mouth, but no words came out.

Lin Fan did not ask him any more questions. He raised his super smart watch and said, “Verify the information.”

The super smart watch did not take long at all and said directly, “Yes, his father, Xiong Anqing, was promoted to a manager of the Imperial Hotel two months ago.”

“Fire him,” Lin Fan said.

“Yes, Master,” the super smart watch said.

Xiong Kai seemed to have finally reacted and said, “You… You’re joking, right?”

At this moment, Xiong Kai’s phone suddenly rang.

He looked at the caller ID. For some reason, he suddenly had a very bad feeling.

He hesitated for a long time before he finally reached out with trembling fingers and pressed the answer button.

The next moment, a 3D projection of a bald man in a white shirt appeared in front of him.

The bald man said hysterically, “Xiong Kai, tell me, what the hell did you do?”

Xiong Kai stammered, “I… I didn’t do anything.”

“You didn’t do anything?” the bald man shouted.

“I’m telling you, the general manager just called me personally to tell me that I’m fired!

“That’s the general manager of the Imperial Hotel! I’ve only seen him from afar a few times!

“In the end, he called me personally!

“Do you know how much I paid to become a department manager?!”

The bald man sputtered out saliva while talking, his entire face red with anger.

Obviously, he was extremely angry.

“I’ll deal with you later, you bastard!”

After saying this, the bald man hung up the phone.

Xiong Kai’s face was deathly pale.

His father’s job at the Imperial Hotel was gone!

The reason why he was able to live so comfortably was entirely because of his father’s high salary.

What should he do in the future?

He still had a mortgage, a car loan, and a credit card…

In addition, his father was going to teach him a lesson later…

He would definitely be very miserable…

Thinking of this, Xiong Kai’s face turned even paler.

Then, he seemed to have thought of something and turned his gaze to Lin Fan.

Xiong Kai bent his legs and knelt on the ground. He kowtowed to Lin Fan and shouted, “I’m sorry, I’m sorry… I was blind just now. I beg you, please forgive me… Please, let me go…

“My father can’t give up his job at the Imperial Hotel…”

However, no matter how Xiong Kai kowtowed and apologized, Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all.

Then, Xiong Kai kowtowed to Xia Xue. “I beg you, let me go. I’ll kowtow to you, I’ll kowtow to you…”
